name: oneledger
description: Self-hosted shared memory ledger for coding agents, exposed over MCP.
author: OneLedger

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-icons.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/sync-web-embed.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/sync-icons.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/sync-web-embed.mjs && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-release.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vitest run
scripts.pack: node scripts/validate-release.mjs && npm run tauri:build && node scripts/stage-tauri-release.mjs
